methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The output is an estimation - based on a thermal simulation - of the energy consumption for heating and cooling.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper presents the implementation of an automated building energy simulation model generation tool, which reduces cost related to building modeling and simulation.

level_3b.evidence_quote: This paper presents an approach to automate the generation of thermal building models.

stage1.notes: Eligible tool because it embeds and characterises a thermal energy model; application is to buildings, not a closed-list continuous process sector.

multi_site.evidence_quote: A thermal simulation was requested using the entire building model and historical sensor data for the a heating period.

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: One possibility to control energy consumption in buildings is based on estimating the thermal loads of a building.

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: One possibility to control energy consumption in buildings is based on estimating the thermal loads of a building.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: The output of the model generator supports the validation and analysis phase of ISO 50001 regarding forecasting the building performance for validation purposes.

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: These data are fed into an automated tool, which creates a complete 3D model representing an approximation of the real building geometry and physics, a so-called simpliﬁed building model. This enables to perform a thermal building simulation for the measurement period and an appropriate time horizon, using EnergyPlus.
